data.body_html:
Easter week 2026 in Marbella (Friday 3 April – Monday 6 April) is the perfect time for a family yacht charter. With mild spring temperatures, fewer crowds than summer, and calm seas, you can enjoy the Costa del Sol from the water. Whether you want a speedy 2-hour spin or a full-day cruise to Cala del Faro, our fleet departs from Puerto Banús and offers everything from budget-friendly motorboats to luxury flybridges. Read on for weather tips, boat recommendations, and the best anchorages for your Easter holiday.

Easter 2026 Weather in Marbella: What to Expect

April in Marbella brings average highs of 20–22°C and lows around 12°C. Sea temperature sits at about 16°C, so swimming is possible but a wetsuit helps. You can expect 8–9 hours of sunshine daily, with only 5–6 rainy days in the month. Winds are typically light (5–10 knots), making for smooth cruising. A light jacket is handy for early morning departures; by midday, you’ll be comfortable in a t-shirt.

Best Family Yachts for Easter Charter

For families, we recommend the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – both priced at €749/2h or €2,299/8h, all-inclusive. These Tier A boats offer ample deck space, a shaded cockpit, and a bow sunpad. If you have teenagers, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski and costs €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter. For smaller groups, the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) is a fun, affordable option – pricing on request via WhatsApp.

Top Anchorages for Easter Cruises

Within 30–45 minutes of Puerto Banús, you’ll find sheltered coves perfect for families:

  • Cala del Faro – Protected bay, shallow water, ideal for kids.
  • Cala Cortés – Calm, sandy patches, good for snorkelling.
  • Cabopino – Near the dunes, with a beach bar and gentle waves.

All are easily reached from Marbella Marina, and your skipper will anchor safely for swimming and lunch.

What’s Included in Your Charter

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras. For Tier A boats, the price is fully inclusive from €749/2h. Larger boats like the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94 include a jet ski or additional amenities – ask us for details.

Why Book Early for Easter 2026

Easter week is a peak period in Marbella. Family groups book fast, especially for larger yachts. We recommend reserving your boat at least 2–3 weeks in advance to secure your preferred vessel and time slot. Contact us via WhatsApp for personalised advice and to check availability.

Sample Easter Itinerary: Half-Day Cruise

Depart Puerto Banús at 10:00. Cruise south along the Golden Mile, past the Marbella Club and Puente Romano. Anchor at Cala del Faro by 10:45 for swimming and snacks. Enjoy lunch on board (or bring your own). Return to port by 13:00. This 3-hour trip works well with the Astondoa 40 at €749/2h (extendable).
